body:
Overall the PR looks pretty good and I don't think fundamental changes are required here. Most comments concern docstrings and cosmetic changes to the code you implemented.

Feel free to justify your choices if you feel like my comments wouldn't improve the quality/readability of the code.

Two things are still missing from the PR:

- Passing the current tests. I need you to merge the `dev` branch back into yours so the tests that were fixed by the latest update pass.
- Adding unit tests as discussed.

We can also think about updating the [website's page dedicated to error mitigation](https://openqaoa.entropicalabs.com/error-mitigation/spam-twirling/) with explanations on ZNE for potential users.
I was thinking it would be nice to have an example notebook using either SPAM or ZNE or an example for both. Do you think this is possible too? ([see other example notebooks for reference](https://github.com/entropicalabs/openqaoa/tree/main/examples))

A few more comments here.
I approved the test pipeline run, so you'll have more info if the test are passing or not now that you have merged dev back into your branches.

Edit: Please add `mitiq` to the requirement file.

Only minor comments. Good job on the implementation of tests and the recent changes!

I have a clue where the issue lies for the docs tests, try to add the following line in the toctree `openqaoa/docs/source/index.rst`, l.306
```
   notebooks/15_Zero_Noise_Extrapolation.ipynb
```
